title: Recovery step keeps selecting the runtime callsite instead of the JSON helper
description: The triage summary keeps blaming the outer runtime callsite even when the actual malformed tail handling happens inside the shared JSON helper.
expected_behavior: Candidate screening should preserve the helper path strongly enough that the final triage decision can keep it as the primary file.
log_excerpt: JSONDecodeError: Extra data after truncated JSON payload
stacktrace_excerpt:
File "app/engine.py", line 91, in generate_json
  repaired = safe_json_tail(raw_text)
File "app/utils.py", line 188, in safe_json_tail
  raise JSONDecodeError(...)

repository_artifacts.snippet: generate_json delegates repair and fallback handling to safe_json_tail before returning the structured response.
safe_json_tail clips malformed JSON output, strips dangling fragments, and retries parsing on the retained prefix.
reporting utilities only consume the already repaired output and summarize workflow traces.
